name: cubby-ui
description: Framework-agnostic UI component library. Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Always combine base + one variant class. Icon buttons: combine cu-button + cu-button-ghost + cu-button-icon. Add hover shadow for solid variants.

components.name: Card
components.notes: cu-card-hover: opt-in hover shadow (not default). cu-card-elevated: shadow-md. cu-card-content-flush: p-0 for table-in-card.

components.name: Copy Button
components.notes: One-click copy. Put the text in data-cu-copy="...", or point data-cu-copy-target="#selector" at an element (input / textarea / select copy their value; other elements copy trimmed textContent). Handled by a single document-level delegated click listener, so dynamically added buttons work without re-init (removed by CubbyUI.destroy()). On success the button gets data-cu-copied (cu-copy-button-icon hides, cu-copy-button-check shows) and fires cu:copy-button:copy { text }; on failure (Clipboard API unavailable / denied and execCommand fallback fails) it gets data-cu-copy-failed and fires cu:copy-button:error. An optional [data-cu-copy-label] child swaps its text to data-cu-copy-success-text (default "Copied!") / data-cu-copy-error-text (default "Copy failed"). State resets after data-cu-copy-duration ms (default 2000). cu-copy-field wraps a read-only value (cu-copy-field-value: span, code or input readonly) with a copy button for IDs / API keys / commands; cu-copy-field-multiline keeps line breaks for snippets. A11y: Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Success / error messages are announced through a shared visually hidden role="status" aria-live="polite" region (data-cu-copy-live), auto-created when absent. SVG icons use aria-hidden="true".

components.name: Number Input
components.notes: Use native <input type="number"> with min/max/step. Buttons use data-cu-number-decrement / data-cu-number-increment. Give the buttons type="button" so they do not submit a surrounding <form>.

components.name: Combobox
components.notes: Add hidden attribute to content initially. Active item gets cu-combobox-item-active class. Shares listbox CSS with Multi Select. Search filters on every keystroke by default; optional data-cu-combobox-debounce="300" on the root delays filtering by N ms (clearing the query, arrow keys and Enter apply pending filtering immediately). Fires cu:combobox:change ({ value, item }) on selection and cu:combobox:search ({ query }) when the applied query changes (hook remote search here: replace the data-cu-combobox-item elements with the results — items added after init get option semantics and update the empty state; keep data-cu-combobox-empty in the list). The trigger must be a <button type="button"> (keyboard focusable, never submits a surrounding form).

components.name: Multi Select
components.notes: Each item needs data-cu-value for tag rendering. Add hidden to content initially. Search filters on every keystroke by default; optional data-cu-multi-select-debounce="300" on the root delays filtering by N ms (clearing the query, arrow keys and Enter apply pending filtering immediately). Fires cu:multiselect:change ({ selected }) on selection and cu:multiselect:search ({ query }) when the applied query changes (hook remote search here). The trigger must be a <button type="button"> (a <div> trigger cannot be focused or opened with the keyboard). Structure: cu-multi-select-control (the box) holds data-cu-multi-select-tags and the trigger as siblings — tags get their own remove <button type="button">, so never nest the tags inside the trigger (older markup that does is restructured on init); keep the placeholder in the trigger and the tags container empty. Clicking empty space in the control opens the panel. Removing a tag from the keyboard focuses the next tag's remove button, or the trigger after the last. With a search input the trigger stays a button named by its text, so while tags hide the placeholder it keeps that text as its name (aria-labelledby), unless it has aria-label / aria-labelledby / <label for>. Pre-select items with cu-multi-select-item-active; tags are rendered by JS. Each tag's remove button is named from data-cu-multi-select-remove-text on the root (default "Remove {label}").

components.notes: cu-dropzone-active class auto-toggled on drag. Click on zone triggers file input; dropped files are assigned to the input and a change event is dispatched. components.name: Table
components.notes: Wrap table in cu-table-wrapper for overflow handling. Add cu-table-stacked for mobile card layout (requires data-label on each td).

components.name: Timeline

components.name: Tree View
components.notes: Uses native <details>/<summary> for expand/collapse. cu-tree-leaf-active highlights the selected node. cu-tree-relaxed adds slightly more spacing between items and within nodes.

components.name: Alert
components.notes: cu-alert-accent adds a prominent filled emphasis (full border + tinted background) for stronger visual. Expandable alerts use data-cu-alert-expandable with data-cu-alert-expand-trigger and data-cu-alert-expandable-content.

components.name: Progress
components.notes: Set width via inline style or Tailwind on cu-progress-bar.

components.name: Skeleton

components.name: Spinner
components.notes: Default size determined by font-size context. cu-spinner-lg uses thicker border (border-[3px]). Color classes set text-color which drives border-current.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Container auto-created at bottom-right if not in DOM. Default duration: 5000ms; duration 0 (data-cu-toast-duration='0' on the trigger, or duration: 0 in CubbyUI.toast.show) disables auto-dismiss. Default max stack: 5. data-cu-toast-variant values: default | destructive | success | warning | info. Programmatic API: CubbyUI.toast.show({ title, description, variant, duration, action }) — action: { label, onClick(event, toast) } renders a cu-toast-action-btn that dismisses the toast after onClick unless event.preventDefault() is called — and CubbyUI.toast.promise(asyncFn, { loading, success, error }) for async operations. Generated close buttons are named "Close"; localize with data-cu-toast-close-text on the container (e.g. "關閉通知").

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.notes: Uses native <dialog>. Does NOT close on backdrop click (intentional for blocking confirmation). trigger value must match <dialog id>. The <dialog> must have data-cu-alert-dialog, otherwise cancel / action buttons do nothing and role=alertdialog is not set.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: trigger and content values must match. Default active tab: add cu-tabs-trigger-active to trigger and DO NOT add hidden to its content. Add hidden to all inactive content panels. Closable: put × inside the trigger — a mouse-only target, never a nested button (JS forces aria-hidden and removes role / tabindex). Keyboard: Delete (or Backspace) on a focused closable tab closes it (aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"); focus and, if it was active, selection move to the following tab (previous when last). Fires cu:tabs:close ({ value }). Arrow keys (APG, automatic activation): roving tabindex keeps only the selected tab in the Tab order; Left / Right (swapped in RTL) or Up / Down for a column-laid-out list move focus and select, wrapping; Home / End jump to the first / last; disabled tabs are skipped; aria-orientation follows the current layout.

components.notes: cu-header-nav is always visible by default; add cu-header-nav-{sm|md|lg|xl} to hide below a breakpoint. cu-header-nav-start: nav aligned left (after brand). cu-header-nav-end: nav aligned right (before actions). Header is sticky by default. Mobile nav: slide-in panel from the right with backdrop, auto-clones desktop nav when data-cu-mobile-nav-clone is set. The panel/backdrop are display:none when closed (fully removed from the a11y tree, animated open via @starting-style) and carry the hidden attribute by default to prevent FOUC before CSS loads (JS removes it on open). Add cu-header-mobile-nav-{bp} + cu-header-mobile-backdrop-{bp} (matching the trigger's breakpoint) to fully remove them on desktop. Supports Escape key, backdrop click, scroll lock, focus management.

components.name: Code Block
components.notes: Code container with optional header (language label) and copy button. Default dark theme; add cu-code-block-light for light variant. Copy button can be absolute (no header) or inline (inside header). Clicking [data-cu-code-block-copy] copies the textContent of .cu-code-block-pre (line breaks and whitespace preserved) using the Clipboard API, falling back to execCommand("copy"). On success the button gets data-cu-copied and fires cu:code-block:copy { text }; on failure it gets data-cu-copy-failed and fires cu:code-block:error { error } (both bubble). The [data-cu-code-block-label] text swaps to data-cu-code-block-success-text (default "Copied!") / data-cu-code-block-error-text (default "Copy failed"), set on the root, and is restored after 2000 ms. A11y: messages are announced through the visually hidden role="status" aria-live="polite" region shared with Copy Button (data-cu-copy-live), auto-created when absent. Set language-xxx class on <code> element for third-party syntax highlighting (Prism.js / Highlight.js).

components.name: Chart
components.notes: Wrapper styles for charts drawn by an external library (Chart.js, ECharts, ...) or inline SVG; Cubby UI ships no charting JS. Series colors come from --color-chart-1 ~ --color-chart-5 (fixed order, redefined under .dark); read them with getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-chart-1') and re-render when the .dark class toggles. cu-chart-canvas is position:relative with an explicit height (h-64; -sm h-48, -lg h-80, -square for pie/donut) as Chart.js expects with maintainAspectRatio:false. cu-chart-color-N sets currentColor so swatches and SVG marks (fill/stroke="currentColor") share the palette. cu-chart-empty / cu-chart-loading are absolutely positioned inside cu-chart-canvas; cu-chart-loading-bar heights vary automatically via :nth-child. cu-chart-tooltip is unpositioned (set left/top yourself, e.g. in a Chart.js external tooltip handler). A11y: Give the <canvas> / <svg> role="img" and an aria-label summarising the data (or provide a table view). Set aria-busy="true" on cu-chart-canvas while cu-chart-loading is shown. Legend swatches are aria-hidden; toggleable legend items are <button aria-pressed>.

components.name: Color Picker
components.notes: HSV-based color picker with saturation panel, hue slider, hex input, and optional preset swatches. Supports drag interaction on saturation panel and hue bar. Initial value via data-cu-color-picker-value or hidden input value. Swatch colors set via data-cu-color-picker-swatch attribute. Keyboard: the saturation panel and hue bar become focusable role="slider" (default names "Saturation and brightness" / "Hue", override with aria-label). Saturation panel: Left/Right saturation ±1%, Up/Down brightness ±1% (Shift ×10), PageUp/PageDown brightness ±10%, Home/End saturation 0/100%. Hue: Left/Down −1°, Right/Up +1° (Shift ×10), PageUp/PageDown ±10°, Home/End 0°/360°. Fires cu:color-picker:change ({ value: "#rrggbb" }, bubbles) whenever the user changes the color (continuously while dragging; not on init).

components.name: Command Palette
components.notes: Uses native <dialog> with showModal(). Opens with Ctrl/Cmd+K globally. Supports keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Enter). Filters items by text content or data-cu-command-value. Groups auto-hide when all items are filtered out. Active item highlighted via data-cu-command-active attribute. Closes on backdrop click. Items are queried on demand: items added to / removed from data-cu-command-list after init (e.g. remote results) are filtered, navigable and get their ARIA immediately; CubbyUI.refresh() re-syncs them too.

components.name: Context Menu
components.notes: Right-click triggered context menu. Content is positioned at cursor location. Auto-closes on click, Escape, scroll, or right-click outside. Uses cu-dropdown-item / cu-dropdown-separator for menu items (shared styles). Add hidden attribute to content initially. Keyboard: the container becomes focusable (tabindex=0 unless it already has a tabindex; use -1 to let focusable children receive the shortcut); Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key opens the menu at the focused element. The menu (role=menu) takes focus and points aria-activedescendant at the highlighted item (cu-dropdown-item-highlight): ArrowUp/Down wrap, Home/End, Enter/Space activate, Escape/Tab close; focus returns to where it was. Name the container with aria-label.

components.name: Date Picker
components.notes: Two components: standalone Calendar ([data-cu-calendar]) and Date Picker (trigger + popover calendar). The calendar needs data-cu-calendar-title and data-cu-calendar-grid (day buttons are rendered by JS — leave the grid empty) plus optional data-cu-calendar-prev / data-cu-calendar-next; inside a Date Picker the calendar must also carry data-cu-calendar. Keyboard: arrow keys move by day / week (crossing months), Home / End jump to the first / last day of the month, Enter / Space select. Date constraints via data-cu-calendar-min / data-cu-calendar-max (YYYY-MM-DD). Date Picker shows the formatted date (YYYY/MM/DD) in data-cu-date-picker-value and stores the ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the hidden input[data-cu-date-picker-input], dispatching a bubbling change event on it after each selection; a preset value on that input opens the calendar on that month. Use type="button" on the trigger and nav buttons so they do not submit a surrounding <form>. Day buttons get full-date accessible names and the month title is formatted in the same locale (data-cu-calendar-locale, else the nearest lang, else en-US); the weekday row is static markup to write in the page language. The day grid has a single Tab stop (roving tabindex); opening the Date Picker focuses the selected date, else today.

components.name: Input Group
components.notes: Groups input with addon text/icons. Children border-radius flattened; first-child gets rounded-l-lg, last-child gets rounded-r-lg. Negative margin (-ml-px) prevents double borders. Use cu-input inside the group for the input field.

components.name: Password Input
components.notes: Password field with show/hide toggle button. Toggle switches input type between password and text. Icon elements (show/hide) are toggled via display:none. Place two icon elements inside the toggle button, one with data-cu-password-icon-show (visible when type=password) and one with data-cu-password-icon-hide (visible when type=text, initially hidden).

components.name: Pin Input
components.notes: OTP / verification code input. Each field accepts one character, auto-advances on input. Backspace moves to previous field. Supports paste across all fields. Set data-cu-pin-input-type="numeric" to restrict to digits only.

components.name: Resizable Panels
components.notes: Drag-to-resize panel layout. Default is horizontal (col-resize); add cu-resizable-vertical for vertical (row-resize). Panel sizes controlled via flex-grow, auto-distributed equally on init. Handles support mouse, touch, and keyboard (arrow keys, step=5). Min/max constraints via data-cu-min-size / data-cu-max-size (percentage values). data-cu-resizing attribute set on handle during active drag.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.notes: Switchable button group. Single selection by default; add data-cu-toggle-group-multiple for multi-select. Outline variant for bordered style. Fires cu:toggle-group:change event.

components.name: Rating
components.notes: Star rating component. Use cu-rating-readonly (<span> stars, role="img" + aria-label) for display-only, data-cu-rating for interactive. Interactive stars are <button type="button"> with data-cu-rating-star="N" (1-based; the star count is the number of stars); data-cu-rating-value="N" on the root is the selected value (0 = none). JS follows the WAI-ARIA APG rating radio group: the root gets role="radiogroup" (name it with aria-label / aria-labelledby, default "Rating"), each star role="radio" + aria-checked and a roving tabindex (one Tab stop). Keys: Arrow Right / Down next star, Arrow Left / Up previous (wrap; mirrored in RTL), Home / End first / last, Space / Enter select. Stars are named "1 star" / "N stars"; localize with data-cu-rating-star-text="{value} 顆星" on the root, a star's own aria-label wins. cu-rating-readonly keeps one Tab stop and sets aria-readonly, cu-rating-disabled removes the stars from the Tab order and sets aria-disabled. Half stars via cu-rating-item-half with CSS clip-path (display only). Fires cu:rating:change ({ value }) when the user changes the value; setting data-cu-rating-value from code re-syncs the stars, aria-checked and the Tab stop without firing it, and cu-rating-readonly / cu-rating-disabled can be toggled at any time. No-JS form rating: each star is a <label class="cu-rating-label"> wrapping an <input type="radio" class="cu-rating-input"> (visually hidden, same name, aria-label "N stars") followed by the star svg, inside a root with role="radiogroup" + aria-label and without data-cu-rating; the checked star and every star before it are filled via CSS :has(), hovering previews a value, the value is submitted with the form and the keyboard is the native radio group (Tab to the checked star, arrows select previous / next). Use checked for a default, required on one radio, disabled on every radio to disable; a selection cannot be cleared. In forced colors mode selected stars use the Highlight system color and unselected stars are outlines.
